svg.text: One revision round: the guard keeps the person's edits
A run of work.py on a 5-slide test deck. Each row is a version in .versions/;
each box is a slide, compared with the base version by its sha256.

svg.text: The photo is still on slide 4.
What the guard counts as a violation
A slide outside the scope that was modified, deleted or moved. A shared file (shared.css,
assets/, the deck outside its slides) that changed, unless open --shared was given.
Deleting a slide in the scope is fine; declare it with open --remove.
